relationships.subject: Intravenous lidocaine
relationships.evidence_quote: At 1 hour, MMP-9 was higher in LIDO group than in the DEX group

relationships.subject: Dexmedetomidine
relationships.evidence_quote: The DEX group was associated with increased CD73 + CD8 + T cells compared with the LIDO group

key_findings: Plasma MMP-9 at 1 h was higher with IV lidocaine than dexmedetomidine or intrathecal morphine in colorectal surgery.
Intrathecal morphine gave lower dynamic pain scores with minimal immune impact.
